title_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale with mortgage in Astir
description_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale on the 5th floor in a new building with an elevator. The apartment has a total area of ​​107 m2, and a net area of ​​97.2 m2. It is organized at the entrance to the common living room with the cooking and dining area, distribution corridor, two bedrooms, two bathrooms where one is located in the matrimonial room and two balconies, one with access from the matrimonial room and the other with access from the living room and the children's room. With mortgage. Immediate access to the main road, the bus station, very close to bars-restaurants, supermarkets, health centers, etc. Address: Astir near Viles L, Price: 139,000 Euros
